formulas.R1_itt_effect: follow * effect  (relative change in trips per driver-hour, pilot group minus comparison group)
formulas.R1_resid_sd: sqrt((sigma_b^2 + sigma_w^2/weeks) * (1 - rho^2)), rho = sigma_b^2 / (sigma_b^2 + sigma_w^2/weeks)
formulas.R2_group_shift_reading_A: use * pp  (pp applies to users only)
formulas.R2_breakeven_volume_ratio: weekday night share / weekend night share (weekend daily volume as a fraction of weekday daily volume below which weekend nights hold fewer trips)
formulas.R3_residual_margin: Delta_main - k * Delta_drift; SE from the two 95% CIs, assuming independence
